From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KPI Readout + QBR Readiness — Ownership & Next Steps

Team,

Attached is the month-of-August KPI package for leadership review ahead of next week's QBR prep slot. High-level notes up front (details in the PDF + attached delta CSV):

- Latency: p50 stable at 72ms, p95 increased from 420ms -> 540ms month-over-month driven by a new long-tail for seq_len>1k requests (see page 6).
- Cost: Cost-per-1M tokens up ~9% due to heavier peak-hour usage and increased retry/timeout-induced token replays. We have a preliminary batching configuration that should recover ~3–4% if applied.
- Uptime: 99.996% (one short maintenance-induced outage on 2027-08-03 for 18m). Pages 2–3 show the incident timeline and RCA draft.
- Usage: Active seats and burst traffic grew 14% MoM in EU cluster; this explains most of the latency tail.

Asks / owner calls:
1) Irene — validate the proposed autoscaling tweak (attached notes) and confirm whether we can push the config to Dedicated staging by EOD Tue 2027-08-16.
2) Jonas — run a targeted load test simulating EU peak-hour GC patterns; prefer a 2-hour window and share raw traces.
3) Marissa — please confirm if the QBR slot on 2027-08-19 (09:00 PT) remains the forum for the leadership readout.

I will consolidate owners' updates into the QBR prep doc and circulate a 10-slide readout (operational summary + ask list) by COB 2027-08-17.

Attachments: 2027-08-kpi-dashboard.pdf (main slides), kpi-delta-table-aug-2027.csv (raw numbers).

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KPI Readout + QBR Readiness — Ownership & Next Steps

Thanks — quick responses inline.

> Latency: p95 increased from 420ms -> 540ms driven by seq_len>1k

Agreed that's the main signal. We saw the same pattern in internal shadow runs when customers hit longer context lengths. Proposed mitigation: enable per-model dynamic batching threshold (lower max batch size for long-context requests) + bump Dedicated burst headroom for EU by 15% for 72 hours to smooth the immediate tail. I attached a short config diff to the shared drive (link in thread meta).

> Asks: validate autoscaling tweak and push to Dedicated staging by EOD Tue 2027-08-16

We can push to staging on Tue EOD but want to run a quick smoke test first. I'll schedule a 30-min window Tue 17:00-17:30 PT and invite infra. If smoke passes, we'll roll to Dedicated canary Wed morning with automatic rollback on error.

Notes: this will increase short-term cost (estimated +2.6% for the EU Dedicated pool over 3 days). Recommend we capture as an OKR micro-experiment under "Serve: SLO stability" so Product signs off.

Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
